title: Can I Know in Advance About Rain, Storms, Fog, Cold, or Heat?
content: Yes, you can get detailed weather forecasts for the next 7 days, including information about rain, storms, fog, cold, or heat to help plan your agricultural activities.

title: How Will I Receive Weather Forecasts?
content: You will receive early warning messages on your mobile phone if the Dr. Chashi app is installed. The alerts provide timely information to prepare for upcoming weather conditions.

title: Can I Get Advance Warnings and Advice on Agricultural Disasters?
content: Yes, you can receive both advance warnings and advisory support for agricultural disasters through the Dr. Chashi app. These alerts help farmers take preventive measures to reduce crop damage.
